callouts.title: 卷积的定义
callouts.body: $f,g$是拓扑群局部紧的可交换群$(G,+)$上由Haar测度$\mu$建立起来的测度空间空间$(G,\mathcal{F},\mu)$当中的两个函数。这两个函数的卷积定义为$$f*g(x):=\int_{G} f(x-y)g(y)\,d\mu(y)$$

callouts.title: 卷积的平移就是平移的卷积
callouts.body:
如果$T_z(f)$表示把函数$f$左平移$z$个单位，即$$T_z(f)=f(x-z)$$那么
$$T_{z}(f*g)=(T_zf)*g=f*(T_zg)$$

classification_result.english_title: Translation of a Convolution Equals the Convolution of Translations

if_problem.statement_en:
If $T_z(f)$ denotes the left translation of $f$ by $z$, namely $T_z(f)=f(x-z)$, then
$$T_{z}(f*g)=(T_zf)*g=f*(T_zg).$$
key_techniques: change of variables in the convolution integral

callouts.title: 卷积的支集与各自的支集的关系
callouts.body: 卷积的支集包含在一个由两个函数分别的支集构成的集合的**闭包**里面。$$\text{supp}(f)+\text{supp}(g)=\{x+y:x\in\text{supp}(f),y\in\text{supp}(g)\}$$

classification_result.english_title: Relation Between the Support of a Convolution and the Supports of the Factors

if_problem.statement_en:
The support of the convolution is contained in the closure of the sum of the supports of the two functions. Here
$$\operatorname{supp}(f)+\operatorname{supp}(g)=\{x+y:x\in\operatorname{supp}(f),\ y\in\operatorname{supp}(g)\}.$$
prerequisites: basic topology of locally compact groups

callouts.title: 函数支集分别是紧的，那么卷积后的支集也紧
callouts.body: 如果分别的支集$\text{supp}(f),\text{supp}(g)$都是紧的，那么$A$紧，那么作为闭子集，$\text{supp}(f*g)$也是紧的。

classification_result.english_title: If the Supports Are Compact, Then the Support of the Convolution Is Also Compact

if_problem.statement_en: If $\operatorname{supp}(f)$ and $\operatorname{supp}(g)$ are both compact, then the support of $f*g$ is also compact.
key_techniques: compactness of sums of compact sets
closed subset of a compact set
interpolation or norm estimates for convolution

callouts.title: 与光滑函数做卷积会得到光滑性
callouts.body: 如果函数$f \in L^1,g\in C^k$并且$\partial^{\alpha} g$有界($\alpha$是多重指标，$|\alpha|\leq k$)那么$$f*g\in C^k$$并且$$\partial^{\alpha}\left(f*g\right)=f*\partial^{\alpha}g$$

classification_result.english_title: Convolution with a Smooth Function Yields Smoothness

if_problem.statement_en:
If $f \in L^1$, $g\in C^k$, and $\partial^{\alpha} g$ is bounded for every multi-index $\alpha$ with $|\alpha|\leq k$, then
$$f*g\in C^k$$
and
$$\partial^{\alpha}\left(f*g\right)=f*\partial^{\alpha}g.$$

callouts.title: 卷积的性质7
callouts.body: $f\in L^p,g\in L^{q}$其中$1/p+1/q=1,p\in[1,+\infty]$那么$f*g$一致连续且有界，并且属于$C_0$。

classification_result.english_title: Convolution of Dual Lebesgue Exponents Is Uniformly Continuous, Bounded, and Vanishes at Infinity

if_problem.statement_en: If $f\in L^p$ and $g\in L^{q}$ with $1/p+1/q=1$ and $p\in[1,+\infty]$, then $f*g$ is uniformly continuous and bounded, and moreover belongs to $C_0$.
key_techniques: approximation by compactly supported continuous functions

callouts.title: 基本想法
callouts.body:
在LCH的条件下(局部紧的Hausdorff空间),$C_0$是$C_c$在一致度量下的闭包或者说$C_c$在$C_0$中式稠密的(这个范数条件非常重要，因为$C_c$在$L^p$下的闭包是$L^p$空间)。

因此要证明某个函数$f\in C_0$只需要证明对任意$\varepsilon >0$存在$f_{\varepsilon}\in C_c$使得$$||f-f_{\varepsilon}||_u <\varepsilon$$即可。因为这样就说明$f$是$C_c$在一致范数导出拓扑下的一个极限点，那么必然属于$C_0$。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Prove Membership in $C_0$ by Uniform Approximation from $C_c$
if_strategy_template.summary_en: On a locally compact Hausdorff space, $C_0$ is the closure of $C_c$ in the uniform norm. Therefore, to prove $f\in C_0$, it suffices to approximate $f$ uniformly by compactly supported continuous functions.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this strategy when you want to show a function vanishes at infinity by constructing approximants in $C_c$ and proving convergence in the sup norm.
